summary: NSE cash and an NFO contract sharing Motilal's wire key ('N', 2885): asked together, the second is refused with the reason; once the cash one goes, the NFO contract subscribes and streams.

notes: The web publishes every subscription from its packet stores every 500 ms (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data); web.json holds the poll after each push, the desktop sends a frame when a packet changes what a subscription reports.

A conditional identity risk shared with the web: only a cash and an F&O contract with the same scrip code meet it. The web accepts both in one subscribe and registers both (motilal_websocket.py:942-966, first registration wins the packets), so live the NFO contract's prices are published as RELIANCE's; the desktop refuses the second while the first holds the code (motilal/wire_keys.rs). The two acknowledgements are not compared with the web here (web.json holds publishes only).

The web answers success for both instruments in the one subscribe and then mixes their prices under ('N', 2885); the desktop refuses the second (a reply the harness compares with this case, not with the web). The client's later subscribe re-registers the NFO contract on the web too, so both publish it once the cash one has gone.

deviations.reason: Before Motilal's day OHLC packet (G) the web sends open, high, low and close as 0 (quote.get(k, 0) in _normalize_quote_data), values it never received; the desktop leaves them out until the G packet (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md: a missing value is not a measured zero).
